obligations.expected_behavior: Every entry in the non-empty Consumer Manifest completes every applicable route transition.
forbidden_result: Any manifest entry fails to complete an applicable route transition.
An applicable route transition is skipped or left incomplete for a manifest entry.
obligations.observable_result: 100% of entries in the non-empty Consumer Manifest are recorded as completing all applicable route transitions.
obligations.state_after: All applicable route transitions for every Consumer Manifest entry are complete.
obligations.state_before: A non-empty Consumer Manifest exists with applicable route transitions in scope.
obligations.subject: Non-empty Consumer Manifest entries and their applicable route transitions
obligations.trigger: When a non-empty Consumer Manifest is processed and its route transitions are applicable.

obligations.expected_behavior: After rollback, every entry in the non-empty Consumer Manifest observes the Prior Behavior Baseline.
forbidden_result: Rollback completes without observing the Prior Behavior Baseline.
Any Consumer Manifest entry lacks a post-rollback baseline observation.
obligations.observable_result: 100% of entries in the non-empty Consumer Manifest have a recorded observation of the Prior Behavior Baseline after rollback.
obligations.state_after: The Prior Behavior Baseline has been observed after rollback for every Consumer Manifest entry.
obligations.state_before: Rollback has occurred for the applicable route transitions, and post-rollback baseline observation is due.
obligations.subject: Post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation for non-empty Consumer Manifest entries
obligations.trigger: After rollback of the applicable route transitions.
